source: Wikipedia, Candidates of the 2026 Victorian state election
page_last_edited: This page was last edited on 31 October 2026, at 11:34 (UTC).

postal.note: Anyone can apply; the online form appears on the VEC page from 9 am Wednesday 4 November. General postal voters need not apply.

early.hours: 9 am to 6 pm daily except Sunday 22 November; closes 6 pm Friday 27 November
early.note: Every early voting centre is also an election-day voting centre this year. The VEC publishes locations closer to the voting period.

low_sensory.note: one low-sensory mobile voting session per district, 10 am to 4 pm

election_day.note: vote at any voting centre in Victoria

voting.nominations_note: Nominations close 12 noon Monday 9 November; the VEC candidate list replaces the Wikipedia register then.
